# Agent Kit

> APM-first, opt-in capabilities with strict source validation.

## Start

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Operating policy.
- [PROJECT.md](PROJECT.md): Identity, toolchain, and commands.
- [projects.md](projects.md): Project ownership.
- [README.md](README.md): Installation and use.

## Contracts

- [Hexagonal Architecture](.agents/knowledge-base/architecture.md): Boundaries and data flow.
- [Decisions](memories/decisions.md): Verified design choices.
- [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md): Runtime and APM limitations.
- [Policy](docs/policy.md): Explicit governance and trust boundaries.
- [Dependency security](docs/dependency-security.md): Audits, licenses, and agent install limits.
- [Migration](docs/migration.md): Adoption, audit ordering, and rollback.
- [Improve the kit](docs/feedback.md): User-level install, the change loop, and approval boundaries.
- [Sources](docs/sources.md): Research and provenance.
- [Agentic development review](docs/agentic-development-review.md): Article
  comparison, evidence-backed improvement plan, review loop and operator checks.
- [Governance](GOVERNANCE.md): Approved ownership and contribution authority.
- [Releasing](docs/releasing.md): Artifact and protected-publication contracts.
- [Agentic setup](.agents/agentic-setup/README.md): Coverage and selected delivery.
- [Setup review](docs/setup-review.md): Original capability mapping and limits.
- [Complete setup](docs/setup-completeness.md): Acceptance plan, resource depth,
  consumer knowledge/guards, native certification and optional MCP adoption.
- [Capability review](docs/capability-review.md): Topic owners and remaining consumer verification.
- [Technology coverage](.agents/agentic-setup/technology-coverage.md): Technologies mapped to instructions, skills and roles.
